title: Printable Watercolor Christmas Stickers
author: Iris Art Studios
description:
Printable Watercolor Christmas Stickers
Printable Stickers, Planner Stickers, Instant Download, Bullet Journal,  Decorative Stickers, Scrapbook Stickers, Cricut Cut File
♥ All elements are hand drawn, you will not find them anywhere else!
♥ This PRINTABLE sticker sheet contains high quality images that look fabulous printed and cut. It comes as a digital download JPG, PDF and transparent PNG format files. Those stickers are perfect for use in your digital planners, notebooks, calendars and more! You can also print these out and cut  them with the help of a cutting machine or some scissors.
______________________________________________________________________________________________
♥ Your DIGITAL Download purchase contains: 
1 x 8.5”x11” sized transparent PNG image file.
1 x 8.5”x11” sized JPG image file.
1 x 8.5”x11” sized PDF file. 
300 PPI.
